The STOP lever (id: lever, attached to official's right side) is also missing its pole/knob — only the floating STOP tag shows, so there's no object for the scroll to be blocking; render the shaft and knob under the label.
Robot's left hand (orange circle) sits right at the canvas edge (x≈2px per lint) — nudge bot's anchor right or scale to ~0.8 so the whole figure stays inside the safe area.
STOP and BILL label bubbles touch/overlap each other — add ~20-30px gap between them so each reads as a distinct tag rather than one merged shape.

Brief calls for a two-panel split with a clear gap/divider; currently it reads as one continuous ground line. Add a vertical rule or widen the gutter between the houses and the official to separate the two beats.

review.verdict: Cast and tone are right (robot for AI, humans/institution for people), but the central joke mechanic — the bill scroll physically blocking the STOP lever — never actually renders as touching or blocking, and secondary props (houses, coin chest, lever shape) are too small or malformed to read, so the piece needs a close look rather than landing in three seconds.
revisionNotes: The scroll never appears between the official's reaching hand and the STOP lever as the brief calls for — move/rescale it to sit at roughly x 0.75, visibly wedged against the lever's handle, so the 'bill blocks the stop' joke actually reads.
The row of houses (scale 0.5 at x 0.48) is too small to register as houses or show a broken-open door — scale to ~0.9 and give the open-door accent a bolder color/larger shape so the break-in reads.
The coin chest has no visible glow or coin shapes, so it reads as a plain lunchbox — scale it up to ~0.8 and keep the glow circle visible so it reads as a chest of coins/wallet.
The lever renders as a flat red capsule on the ground instead of a pole-and-handle shape — rebuild with a clear vertical rod and round STOP handle so it reads at a glance.
The official's pointing arm stretches unnaturally far across the right panel, reading as a broken limb rather than a reach — shorten it to a natural proportion.
The vertical divider line is nearly invisible against the cream background — thicken it or raise contrast so the two-panel split described in the brief is legible.
